CodeLima 0.3.4 gives ordinary terminal tabs short, unnumbered names.

- Guest shells display `shell`; host shells display `host`.
- Common shell names and username/path titles use these defaults, including
  when multiple tabs have the same name.
- Application titles, spinners, progress and bell indicators remain visible.
  Application-provided suffixes such as ` | codelima` are preserved; CodeLima
  does not append a node name. Host application titles retain `host:`.
- Returning to an ordinary shell title or clearing the title restores the
  default. Moving and closing tabs never adds numbers.

Upgrade with Homebrew:

```sh
brew update
brew upgrade codelima
codelima daemon update
codelima --version
```

Reopen attached TUIs to use the new names. Daemon protocol 7 and the native
renderer dependency are unchanged from 0.3.3.

**Qualification status:** local Linux arm64 automated and live host-TUI checks
pass; publication requires verification, race, integration and package checks
on macOS arm64 and Linux amd64/arm64. Native physical-terminal, real Lima
VM/forwarding, actual Homebrew upgrade and the full interactive QA matrix
remain incomplete, along with the deferred full upstream Ghostty Debug suite.
These limits remain tracked in TODO #41/#44/#51; publication does not mark them
complete. See the
[qualification report](https://github.com/brianrackle/codelima/blob/main/plans/compact_tab_release_qa.md).

Archives contain both `codelima` and `codelima-renderer-worker`; keep them
together for manual installations. Supported targets are macOS arm64,
Linux amd64, and Linux arm64.
